column1: # Lucene 10.5.0 lucene-sandbox: every top-level class of the jar, and what became of it.
# Checked by scripts/check-port-inventory.py --module sandbox (see its docstring for the statuses).

column3: the query profiler wraps each Weight/Scorer/BulkScorer of a Java query tree, which this port does not build (queries execute as Rust enums); its nanosecond timings would not be comparable with Lucene's anyway, and OpenSearch profiles with its own org.opensearch.search.profile.query (QueryProfiler, ProfileWeight), never this class
